privacy.band_hint_hide: Drag a box with the mouse over the part of the screenshot to hide.
privacy.band_hint_open: Drag a box with the mouse over the part of the screenshot to reveal.
privacy.band_nothing: Nothing to reveal here: choose a place that is covered
privacy.maybe_iban: Looks like an IBAN, please check. The checksum did not match, so it is not hidden automatically. If it is an IBAN, choose Hide completely.
privacy.maybe_iban_label: Looks like an IBAN, please check. It is next to an account label, so it is hidden right away. If it is not an IBAN, choose Show completely.
privacy.maybe_iban_shape: Looks like an IBAN, please check. It has the shape of an account number, so it is hidden right away. If it is not an IBAN, choose Show completely.
privacy.none_hint: If something on the screenshot needs hiding, select it by hand with the Blur tool.
privacy.note: The search runs on your computer: nothing is sent or saved.
privacy.tip:
Hide personal data (H)
Phones, emails, card numbers and keys are covered with a solid fill
privacy.title: Personal data
privacy.tool_hide_tip: Drag over any spot you want covered, even if the program did not find it (Shift+U)
privacy.tool_open_tip: Drag over a part of a covered spot to reveal it (U)
